Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

Stack: C++ (MinGW), Go, TypeScript/React. Build: `npm run build` (or `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`); test: `npm run test`.

Privacy/local-first: data stays local; minimize cloud exposure. Offline operation; external calls only when needed (Gmail sending). Prefer no-cost services. Ship pragmatically, use strict TypeScript, keep related code together, minimize files/bloat, colocate code. Use React Bootstrap/Radix or similar; no Tailwind. Prepare for translations using message catalogs/i18n; technical docs stay English.

**Interceptor (`src/interceptor/`)**: Simple MAPI only (not Extended MAPI/COM); capture calls to JSON in `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json—hand-rolled JSON). Non-blocking; thread-safe. Files: `main.cpp`, `mapi_impl.cpp`, `json_writer.cpp`, `fs_utils.cpp`. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Test multiple calling applications (Explorer, PDF viewers, etc.); check memory leaks and thread safety.

**Native host (`src/native-host/`)**: Bridge filesystem to Chrome Native Messaging (length-prefixed JSON: email, removed, ready, process, delete). Files: `main.go`, `protocol.go`, `watcher.go` (fsnotify). Run `gofmt` before committing. Test native messaging with extension; handle deleted files and permission errors.

**Extension (`src/extension/`)**: React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API for OAuth. Key files: `manifest.json` (MV3), `src/background/service-worker.ts`, `src/popup/App.tsx`, `src/types/messages.ts`. Use React Bootstrap; keep service worker minimal, offload to popup when possible. TypeScript strict mode required. Test Chrome and Edge.

JSON files `%TEMP%\go-mapi\*.json`; schema: [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json).

Docs: README user-focused; CONTRIBUTING developer-focused; AGENTS technical context; ROADMAP phases, not timelines. Comment why, not what; document non-obvious constraints; concise comments. Use Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`.

Workflow: understand affected component; read sources/patterns; check/run tests; identify related files. Follow patterns, keep changes minimal/focused, add tests, update docs for behavior changes. Run `npm run build`, `npm run test`; manually test user-facing changes; write clear commits.

Personas: C++ minimal/non-blocking, avoid dependencies; Go filesystem watching/native messaging; frontend React/Gmail; DevOps `.github/workflows/` Windows builds.

New JSON field: update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript `src/extension/src/types/`, Go structs in `src/native-host/`.
Setting: Chrome storage API, settings UI, service worker, persist with `chrome.storage.sync`.
Manual release check: `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi` (admin); load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; check `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` and extension DevTools.

Decisions: MinGW over MSVC; React Bootstrap; JSON files in `%TEMP%`.
